meta.title: Find your starting point
meta.description: Six short questions about where you are right now. Get your stage and a path chosen for you, in about a minute.

intro.title: Find your starting point
intro.lead: Six short questions about where you are right now. There are no wrong answers, and nothing here is a test.
intro.note: About one minute. You can go back and change any answer.

flow.stripCaption: Your stage takes shape as you answer.

shahada.title: When did you take your shahada?

wudu.title: Wudu is the washing before prayer. How are you with it?
wudu.helper: Most people start here. That is completely fine.

options.notYet: I have not learned it yet
options.withGuide: I can do it with a guide

prayer.title: How is your prayer going?
prayer.helper: Learning to pray takes time for everyone.

options.learning: I am learning the movements and words
options.some: I pray, but not all five every day
options.allFive: I pray all five most days

quran.title: How much of the Quran can you recite in prayer?
quran.helper: Al-Fatiha is the opening chapter of the Quran, recited in every prayer.

options.fewSurahs: Al-Fatiha and a few short surahs

belief.title: The six pillars of faith and the five pillars of Islam: how familiar are they?

options.explain: I could explain them to a friend

support.title: Is anyone helping you learn right now?
support.helper: There is no right answer. This helps us support you.

options.alone: No, I am learning on my own

result.title: Your starting point: Stage {number}, {name}

reasons.wuduFirst: Wudu comes first, because every prayer begins with it.
reasons.prayerFirst: Learning to pray, one step at a time, is the next thing to build.
reasons.prayerConsistency: Making all five prayers a steady habit is a good next goal.
reasons.quranNext: Learning short surahs to recite in prayer is a good next step.
reasons.beliefNext: The pillars of faith and of Islam are worth getting to know well.
reasons.readyForDepth: Your prayer and the basics are in place, so you are ready to go deeper.
reasons.solidBasics: Your basics are solid. This stage helps you build on them.

result.fallback: Paths for the {stage} stage are being prepared. Until they are ready, this is the best place to begin.

noPath.title: Paths for your stage are being prepared
noPath.body: In the meantime, the library has short lessons you can explore at your own pace.

mentor.title: You do not have to learn alone
mentor.body: You mentioned you are learning on your own. You can ask for a mentor: a volunteer, an experienced Muslim, matched with you by our team.

result.guest: Your starting point is saved on this device. <link>Create a free account</link> to keep your place wherever you sign in.
result.guestUnsaved: <link>Create a free account</link> to keep your starting point and your progress.

adjust.open: Not quite right? Choose your stage yourself
adjust.title: Choose your stage
adjust.hint: Pick the stage that feels closest to where you are. You can change it at any time.

save.error: We could not save your starting point.

pathsError.title: We could not load the paths just now
pathsError.body: Your starting point still works. Try again in a moment, or browse the paths yourself.
